notes: Four transmitters at the head «كلهم عن ابن علية» are co-transmitters in one level.
«- واللفظ ليحيى قال حدثنا ابن علية -» is a wording note in the editor's dashes: left out; «عبد العزيز، بن صهيب» is one man (comma, no «و»).
The Companion Anas is the last link; the Prophet's words are the saying.
